title: Brigade Stomp
description: Energetic acoustic swing hot jazz for gameplay. Short alto-sax/clarinet hooks, clipped brass responses, upright walking bass and brush ride. Stop-time holes leave room for bubble captures and rescues; C minor with chromatic approaches and dominant/diminished color.
provenance: Original composition generated by compose-period-band.py. No borrowed melodies or audio samples in score.
intent: 1930s–1940s small acoustic cartoon jazz band for the illustrated dragon castle; no electronic lead or pads.
timing: Swung offbeats, independent player offsets, per-note timing and velocity, short articulated wind phrases.
limitation: A newly composed period-inspired arrangement, not a recreation of a historical recording. Sampler rendering quality is separate from composition.
